meta.name: google-cloud-waf-reliability
meta.description: Generates reliability-focused guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the design principles and recommendations in the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework. Use this skill to evaluate a workload, identify reliability requirements, and provide actionable recommendations for build, deploy, and manage the workload reliably in Google Cloud.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据 Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework 的可靠性支柱，评估你的工作负载，识别可靠性需求，并提供构建、部署和管理的可操作建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何提高 Google Cloud 工作负载的可靠性，或要求评估现有架构时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 GKE 集群的可靠性。
say.note: Claude 会询问相关问题并给出建议。

say.text: 如何为我的 Cloud Run 服务设置 SLO？
say.note: Claude 会提供基于框架的指导。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude evaluates your Google Cloud workload based on the Reliability pillar of the Well-Architected Framework, identifies reliability requirements, and provides actionable recommendations for building, deploying, and managing reliably.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about improving reliability of Google Cloud workloads or request an architecture evaluation.

say_en.text: Evaluate the reliability of my GKE cluster.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and provide recommendations.

say_en.text: How do I set SLOs for my Cloud Run service?
